text: The Wi-Fi in meeting room 3B drops every few minutes. It is not just my laptop, everyone in the room loses the connection. We have the quarterly review in there at 3pm.
I dropped my laptop at the airport. It still turns on but there is a crack across the screen and the bottom half flickers. I can work with an external monitor for now.
Outlook keeps telling me my password is wrong. I changed it yesterday when the reminder came up and now I can't get into email or the visitor system. I think my account is locked.
Since this week's update the spreadsheet app crashes whenever I open a file that has macros. Files without macros open fine. I've already restarted twice.
I've moved to the recruiting team and need to see the shared Recruiting folder. My new manager, Ben, has approved it by email. No rush, sometime this week is fine.
Working from home today. The VPN says connected, but the internal wiki and the stock system both time out. Normal websites load fine.
The coffee machine in the second-floor kitchen shows error E17 and won't make anything. Who should I tell?
The printer by the fourth-floor lifts prints completely blank pages. I reinstalled the driver like the wiki says and it made no difference. Other people's jobs come out blank too.
